title: Sokaler Sure
desc: Talented singers and artists perform some of the most popular devotional and folk songs of Bengali music and enthral the audience with their performance.

title: Amar Prem
desc: Subho and Deepika struggle to unite owing to Deepika's father who disapproves of Subho. Meanwhile, her father betroths her to an evil man who is only interested in their family's property.

title: Pratisodh
desc: Ranjan is sent to jail under false allegations by his uncle. However, he strives to take revenge and teach his uncle a lesson.

title: Rupban
desc: A 12-year-old Rupban is married to Rahim when he is just 12 days old. However, their lives take a turn when Rahim grows older, only to refuse to accept Rupban as his wife and fall in love with Tajel.

title: Bidrohini Naari
desc: Saathi, a rebel, marries a rich man named Partho, but his family fails to welcome her. However, when her maid gets molested by her brother-in-law, she raises her voice against her in-laws.
